claims.claim: ⚠️ **Suspected SMA is now treated as an emergency:** confirm the genetic diagnosis, including the SMN2 copy number, and start treatment quickly.
claims.locator: Cure SMA expert panel (Schroth M, Deans J, Bharucha Goebel DX, Burnette WB, et al.), Neurology: Clinical Practice vol 15, doi 10.1212/CPJ.0000000000200374, 'Spinal Muscular Atrophy Update in Best Practices: Recommendations for Treatment Considerations', published online 8 October 2024 (February 2025 issue), https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11464225/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Classifying SMA by type no longer predicts prognosis or outcome well** in the treatment era.
claims.locator: Cure SMA expert panel (Schroth M, Deans J, Bharucha Goebel DX, Burnette WB, et al.), Neurology: Clinical Practice vol 15, doi 10.1212/CPJ.0000000000200374, 'Spinal Muscular Atrophy Update in Best Practices: Recommendations for Treatment Considerations', published online 8 October 2024 (February 2025 issue), https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11464225/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Earlier treatment gives better results, so treat as soon as is reasonably possible after diagnosis.** No current drug cures SMA.
claims.locator: Cure SMA expert panel (Schroth M, Deans J, Bharucha Goebel DX, Burnette WB, et al.), Neurology: Clinical Practice vol 15, doi 10.1212/CPJ.0000000000200374, 'Spinal Muscular Atrophy Update in Best Practices: Recommendations for Treatment Considerations', published online 8 October 2024 (February 2025 issue), https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11464225/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Every start, change, addition or stop should weigh two things:** what the patient and family want, and the drug's safety and side effects. (89% panel agreement)
claims.locator: Cure SMA expert panel (Schroth M, Deans J, Bharucha Goebel DX, Burnette WB, et al.), Neurology: Clinical Practice vol 15, doi 10.1212/CPJ.0000000000200374, 'Spinal Muscular Atrophy Update in Best Practices: Recommendations for Treatment Considerations', published online 8 October 2024 (February 2025 issue), https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11464225/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Children under 2 have up to 3 SMN-enhancing options; older people have 2.** Onasemnogene abeparvovec is a single intravenous gene-transfer dose for infants and toddlers.
claims.locator: Cure SMA expert panel (Schroth M, Deans J, Bharucha Goebel DX, Burnette WB, et al.), Neurology: Clinical Practice vol 15, doi 10.1212/CPJ.0000000000200374, 'Spinal Muscular Atrophy Update in Best Practices: Recommendations for Treatment Considerations', published online 8 October 2024 (February 2025 issue), https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11464225/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Nusinersen** (antisense oligonucleotide) is given intrathecally: 4 loading doses across 2 months, then a maintenance dose every 4 months.
claims.locator: Cure SMA expert panel (Schroth M, Deans J, Bharucha Goebel DX, Burnette WB, et al.), Neurology: Clinical Practice vol 15, doi 10.1212/CPJ.0000000000200374, 'Spinal Muscular Atrophy Update in Best Practices: Recommendations for Treatment Considerations', published online 8 October 2024 (February 2025 issue), https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11464225/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Risdiplam** (oral SMN2 splicing modifier) is a liquid taken once daily, by mouth or through a feeding tube.
claims.locator: Cure SMA expert panel (Schroth M, Deans J, Bharucha Goebel DX, Burnette WB, et al.), Neurology: Clinical Practice vol 15, doi 10.1212/CPJ.0000000000200374, 'Spinal Muscular Atrophy Update in Best Practices: Recommendations for Treatment Considerations', published online 8 October 2024 (February 2025 issue), https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11464225/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Current clinical status drives the decision** once someone is past the initial diagnosis: comorbidities, complex spinal anatomy, and any decline in function on treatment. (100% agreement)
claims.locator: Cure SMA expert panel (Schroth M, Deans J, Bharucha Goebel DX, Burnette WB, et al.), Neurology: Clinical Practice vol 15, doi 10.1212/CPJ.0000000000200374, 'Spinal Muscular Atrophy Update in Best Practices: Recommendations for Treatment Considerations', published online 8 October 2024 (February 2025 issue), https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11464225/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Complex spinal anatomy** can make intrathecal dosing risky or intolerable, which may favour a drug given by another route from the outset or a later switch away from intrathecal treatment.
claims.locator: Cure SMA expert panel (Schroth M, Deans J, Bharucha Goebel DX, Burnette WB, et al.), Neurology: Clinical Practice vol 15, doi 10.1212/CPJ.0000000000200374, 'Spinal Muscular Atrophy Update in Best Practices: Recommendations for Treatment Considerations', published online 8 October 2024 (February 2025 issue), https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11464225/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Pre-existing liver disease or raised transaminases** narrows the choice, because gene therapy can worsen liver disease.
claims.locator: Cure SMA expert panel (Schroth M, Deans J, Bharucha Goebel DX, Burnette WB, et al.), Neurology: Clinical Practice vol 15, doi 10.1212/CPJ.0000000000200374, 'Spinal Muscular Atrophy Update in Best Practices: Recommendations for Treatment Considerations', published online 8 October 2024 (February 2025 issue), https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11464225/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Loss of function after years of stability** (for example, no longer walking independently) may mean the drug slowed but did not halt progression. Changing or adding a drug can be discussed, but there are no published data to guide it.
claims.locator: Cure SMA expert panel (Schroth M, Deans J, Bharucha Goebel DX, Burnette WB, et al.), Neurology: Clinical Practice vol 15, doi 10.1212/CPJ.0000000000200374, 'Spinal Muscular Atrophy Update in Best Practices: Recommendations for Treatment Considerations', published online 8 October 2024 (February 2025 issue), https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11464225/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Reproductive plans affect the choice** because data on these drugs in that setting are insufficient.
claims.locator: Cure SMA expert panel (Schroth M, Deans J, Bharucha Goebel DX, Burnette WB, et al.), Neurology: Clinical Practice vol 15, doi 10.1212/CPJ.0000000000200374, 'Spinal Muscular Atrophy Update in Best Practices: Recommendations for Treatment Considerations', published online 8 October 2024 (February 2025 issue), https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11464225/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Factors that matter most for adolescents and adults:** tolerability, quality of life, benefit against burden, side effects, loss of function, male and female reproductive concerns, pregnancy, progression despite treatment, and treatment fatigue.
claims.locator: Cure SMA expert panel (Schroth M, Deans J, Bharucha Goebel DX, Burnette WB, et al.), Neurology: Clinical Practice vol 15, doi 10.1212/CPJ.0000000000200374, 'Spinal Muscular Atrophy Update in Best Practices: Recommendations for Treatment Considerations', published online 8 October 2024 (February 2025 issue), https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11464225/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Adult comorbidities weigh heavily:** complex spinal anatomy, kidney disease and plans for a family.
claims.locator: Cure SMA expert panel (Schroth M, Deans J, Bharucha Goebel DX, Burnette WB, et al.), Neurology: Clinical Practice vol 15, doi 10.1212/CPJ.0000000000200374, 'Spinal Muscular Atrophy Update in Best Practices: Recommendations for Treatment Considerations', published online 8 October 2024 (February 2025 issue), https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11464225/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Set adult goals differently from those for young children:** slower progression, keeping the motor function needed for daily living, and independence. The effect can take 12 months or more to show, and age matters less in the decision.
claims.locator: Cure SMA expert panel (Schroth M, Deans J, Bharucha Goebel DX, Burnette WB, et al.), Neurology: Clinical Practice vol 15, doi 10.1212/CPJ.0000000000200374, 'Spinal Muscular Atrophy Update in Best Practices: Recommendations for Treatment Considerations', published online 8 October 2024 (February 2025 issue), https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11464225/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Gains in older people can be small but meaningful**, such as still driving a powered wheelchair or lifting a cup; stabilisation and better quality of life also count. Responses have been positive at every age and severity.
claims.locator: Cure SMA expert panel (Schroth M, Deans J, Bharucha Goebel DX, Burnette WB, et al.), Neurology: Clinical Practice vol 15, doi 10.1212/CPJ.0000000000200374, 'Spinal Muscular Atrophy Update in Best Practices: Recommendations for Treatment Considerations', published online 8 October 2024 (February 2025 issue), https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11464225/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Give a treatment 6 to 12 months before judging it, unless the reason to change is urgent.** (89% agreement)
claims.locator: Cure SMA expert panel (Schroth M, Deans J, Bharucha Goebel DX, Burnette WB, et al.), Neurology: Clinical Practice vol 15, doi 10.1212/CPJ.0000000000200374, 'Spinal Muscular Atrophy Update in Best Practices: Recommendations for Treatment Considerations', published online 8 October 2024 (February 2025 issue), https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11464225/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Urgent reasons to change sooner** (100% agreement): significant side effects or intolerance, intolerance of the route of administration, significant disease progression, or loss of motor milestones in infants and young children.
claims.locator: Cure SMA expert panel (Schroth M, Deans J, Bharucha Goebel DX, Burnette WB, et al.), Neurology: Clinical Practice vol 15, doi 10.1212/CPJ.0000000000200374, 'Spinal Muscular Atrophy Update in Best Practices: Recommendations for Treatment Considerations', published online 8 October 2024 (February 2025 issue), https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11464225/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Other reasons to review within 6 months:** intolerance of intrathecal injections or of oral-drug gastrointestinal effects, abnormal monitoring bloods, further loss of function in an older person within 2–3 months of starting, pregnancy, or persistent symptoms with no apparent response.
claims.locator: Cure SMA expert panel (Schroth M, Deans J, Bharucha Goebel DX, Burnette WB, et al.), Neurology: Clinical Practice vol 15, doi 10.1212/CPJ.0000000000200374, 'Spinal Muscular Atrophy Update in Best Practices: Recommendations for Treatment Considerations', published online 8 October 2024 (February 2025 issue), https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11464225/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Add-on (combination) treatment is unproven.** It covers any SMN-enhancing drug after gene therapy, or nusinersen with risdiplam at once; its benefit, safety and timing are unknown, and many funders will not pay for it.
claims.locator: Cure SMA expert panel (Schroth M, Deans J, Bharucha Goebel DX, Burnette WB, et al.), Neurology: Clinical Practice vol 15, doi 10.1212/CPJ.0000000000200374, 'Spinal Muscular Atrophy Update in Best Practices: Recommendations for Treatment Considerations', published online 8 October 2024 (February 2025 issue), https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11464225/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Beware funding rules that demand ongoing absolute improvement:** they may ignore the natural history of SMA, and motor scales may miss slowed progression.
claims.locator: Cure SMA expert panel (Schroth M, Deans J, Bharucha Goebel DX, Burnette WB, et al.), Neurology: Clinical Practice vol 15, doi 10.1212/CPJ.0000000000200374, 'Spinal Muscular Atrophy Update in Best Practices: Recommendations for Treatment Considerations', published online 8 October 2024 (February 2025 issue), https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11464225/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Care coordination and multidisciplinary care are essential** to delivering these drugs well, with respiratory, musculoskeletal and nutrition support alongside them.
claims.locator: Cure SMA expert panel (Schroth M, Deans J, Bharucha Goebel DX, Burnette WB, et al.), Neurology: Clinical Practice vol 15, doi 10.1212/CPJ.0000000000200374, 'Spinal Muscular Atrophy Update in Best Practices: Recommendations for Treatment Considerations', published online 8 October 2024 (February 2025 issue), https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11464225/, retrieved 2026-09-23
